Discord.Title: Discord status
Discord.Note: Discord friends see the mode, classes and turn or place.
Discord.SwitchTip: Hearthpulse passes the mode, classes, turn or place to the Discord app on this computer, and Discord shows them to everyone who can see your profile (friends and members of servers you share). Nothing goes anywhere else. Turn it off and the status clears at once.
Discord.Keeps: The status has no names, BattleTags or ratings, yours or your opponents'.
Discord.Status.Waiting: Discord isn't running. Hearthpulse connects once you open it.
Discord.Status.NotConfigured: Not available yet: Hearthpulse isn't registered with Discord.
